SELECT COUNT(*), MIN(sale_date), MAX(sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT sale_date, SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT DISTINCT sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB' AND sale_date >= '2025-11-01'
ORDER BY sale_date DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label, r.fully_loaded
FROM dim_date d
LEFT JOIN ref_fiscal_calendar r ON (d.fiscal_year = r.fiscal_year AND d.fiscal_period = r.fiscal_period)
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23'
ORDER BY d.calendar_date

SELECT COUNT(*) as web_order_count, 
       SUM(order_total_gross) as total_gross
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23'

SELECT sale_date, COUNT(*) as line_count, SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-10' AND '2025-12-25'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT sale_date, SUM(net_amount) as net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE channel_code = 'WB' AND sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY sale_date
ORDER BY sale_date

SELECT DISTINCT channel_code, channel_id, COUNT(*) as line_count
FROM fact_sales_line
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2025-12-15' AND '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY channel_code, channel_id
ORDER BY line_count DESC
